summary: Verified the NGRBCPolicyMatrixRenderer fix end-to-end. Login as admin, navigated to BRSR > Section B, exercised both 'together' and 'separate' modes of the ngrbc_policy_matrix question, saved as draft, reloaded, submitted for approval, and inspected the Approver Queue. All primary requirements from the review request pass: status transitions from 'Pending' to 'Draft' after Save Draft; the value is persisted (not null) with the expected data structure; both modes work; and NGRBCPolicyMatrixDisplay renders correctly inside the Approver Queue modal.

Same issue on queue list row title. Cosmetic but confusing for reviewers.

action_items: (Optional/Low) Show real question text instead of description in ApproverQueue row and modal header for ngrbc_policy_matrix items.
(Optional/Low) Fix the '0 pending submissions' counter on Approver Queue when items are actually present.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix looks correct: switched from useState + initialized guard to a controlled/direct-onChange pattern, mirroring PrincipleToggleRenderer. Every interaction pushes a complete object upward, so a Save Draft immediately after any interaction (including the very first) now has the intended value.

Data shape actually persisted by backend uses per-year suffixed keys (e.g. mode_current_fy, all_together.covered_current_fy, principle_wise.P1_current_fy). This is the BRSR multi-year unification. Frontend NGRBCPolicyMatrixRenderer reads/writes the plain shape and the service transforms it - round trip verified working. Not a bug but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing BRSR Section B question configs. Created a Draft and one Submitted (UPDATE) submission for ngrbc_policy_matrix under FY 2026-2027 during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The ngrbc_policy_matrix bug is fixed. Draft save transitions status Pending -> Draft immediately; value stored correctly for both mode='together' and mode='separate'. Approver Queue renders NGRBCPolicyMatrixDisplay properly (Mode + P1..P9 rows with Covered / Board). Backend stores fields with _current_fy suffix on the per-year keys - this is intended by the unified BRSR multi-year store and is handled by service._save_to_unified_collection. Two low-priority cosmetic items (title uses description; queue counter shows 0) are unrelated to this fix.
rca of the issue: Old NGRBCPolicyMatrixRenderer used a local useState seeded from `value` prop with an `initialized` guard so that onChange only fired after first mount. For a NEW question with `value === undefined`, `initialized` stayed false forever, so no onChange was ever dispatched to the parent form. When the user clicked Save Draft, the parent form's draft_data had no entry for ngrbc_policy_matrix -> backend stored null and the status defaulted to Pending. Fix: removed local state; derive `data` directly from `value || defaults` and call `onChange(newData)` on every interaction. Now the parent always receives the latest full object, so Save Draft persists a real value and status flips to Draft. Verified via UI (both modes), page reload, and direct GET on /api/esg-questionnaire/responses/BRSR/section_b/FY%202026-2027.
